name: Migraine Diary
description: For anyone who wants to track their own headaches, including people without a migraine diagnosis. Basic logging is the default: attack date, start time, and severity. The optional questionnaire is off by default and covers details such as duration, symptoms, and medication. To start it for a saved entry, type “Continue the optional questions for this entry” in the same chat. You can skip optional questions.

display_description.zh: 适合想记录自己头痛情况的人，无需确诊偏头痛。默认使用基础记录，包括发作日期、开始时间和严重程度。可选问卷默认关闭，可用于补充持续时间、其他症状、用药等信息。若要为已保存的记录开启问卷，请在同一聊天中输入“继续这条记录的可选问题”。可跳过不想回答的问题。
